2607.01083.title: Staleness-Learning Rate Scaling Laws for Asynchronous RLHF
2607.01083.paper_summary: High-throughput RLHF systems often decouple rollout generation from policy optimization, leading to the use of stale rollouts during learner updates. In this work, we study the effect of such staleness in asynchronous GRPO. We make the behavior policy explicit in the GRPO surrogate objective and distinguish between the surrogate-gradient mapping used by the learner and the true total derivative of a distribution-dependent population objective. Under assumptions of local boundedness, distributional smoothness, and behavior-policy smoothness, we show that stale rollouts introduce a per-step surrogate-gradient bias of order O(S * eta), where S denotes the maximum rollout lag and eta denotes the learning rate. We further derive a conditional collapse-time scaling law: when within-cycle drift remains below a batch-level clipping radius, collapse is governed primarily by cumulative learner drift T * eta; when the stale-rollout constraint is active, stability instead depends explicitly on S * eta. This yields a two-constraint stability condition eta << min{R_batch / (S * G_upd), R_crit / (T * G_upd)}, explaining why the maximum stable learning rate may appear weakly dependent on staleness in the horizon-limited regime.
2607.01083.paper_summary_zh: 高通量的RLHF系統通常將回合生成與策略優化解耦，導致在學習者更新期間使用過時的回合。在這項工作中，我們研究了這種過時性在非同步GRPO中的影響。我們在GRPO的代理目標中明確了行為策略，並區分了學習者使用的代理梯度映射和依賴於分佈的總導數的群體目標。在局部有界性、分佈平滑性和行為策略平滑性的假設下，我們顯示過時的回合引入了每步代理梯度偏差的順序為O(S * eta)，其中S表示最大回合延遲，eta表示學習率。我們進一步推導出一個條件崩潰時間縮放定律：當循環內漂移保持在批次級別裁剪半徑以下時，崩潰主要由累積學習者漂移T * eta主導；當過時回合約束有效時，穩定性則明確依賴於S * eta。這導致了一個雙約束穩定性條件eta << min{R_batch / (S * G_upd), R_crit / (T * G_upd)}，解釋了為什麼最大穩定學習率在有限視野範圍內可能顯得對過時性弱依賴。
